reason: The preregistered scorer rejects snapshot-specific LoRA pairs by requiring old/new adapter digests to be equal. The frozen generation registration assigns distinct adapters to each snapshot.
deviation: This deterministic scorer amendment was defined after generation and before scoring, in response to the scorer's metadata validation failure. No generated output text or embedding values were inspected before freezing this amendment.
adapter_pair_rule: Validate every raw record's LoRA digest against the frozen generation registration for that repository and snapshot; allow old/new digests to differ for lora. Require null adapters for base and prompt-only controls.
metric: cosine similarity of paired output embeddings; not semantic ground truth
labels_limit: Objective public-interface labels are not behavioral or semantic truth.
